title: [Card Bug] Fear, Fire, Foes! Incorrectly deals 1 damage to all other creatures instead of all other creatures with the same controller

server.source: isolated v0.103.0 single-user server on 127.0.0.1:9374 (started fresh for this run; games.db + server.log in runs/20261008-7021/).

scope: Fear, Fire, Foes! secondary 1-damage clause across three controller seats; native engine, three human-client seats, X=2

assertion_details.A1_parse_gap: DamageAll target = Typed {Creature, controller:None, properties:['Another']} - no same-controller filter (parse drops the clause)
assertion_details.A4_same_controller_hit: P1 other mystics post=[] -> passed (expected 0 survivors: target takes X=2, other takes the 1)
assertion_details.A5_caster_spared: P0 mystics post=[] -> FAILED (expected >=1: caster's creature takes 0)
assertion_details.A6_third_party_spared: P2 mystics post=[] -> FAILED (expected >=1: third party takes 0)

rejection.message: That action belongs to a different player.
That action belongs to a different player.
